note: Global site header -- renders: Booking.com logo, language/currency selectors, 'Sign in'/'Register' links, and fixed service tabs (Accommodations/Flights/Packages/Cars/Attractions/Airport taxis)
Hotel page section tabs -- renders: Overview/Availability/Facilities/Policies/Fine print/Reviews
Booking action bar -- renders: 'Add to wishlist', 'Share', 'Book now', 'Price guarantee' controls
Hotel header controls -- renders: 'Save' button, 'Show on map' button, and 'Check availability' button
Photo gallery navigation -- renders: 'Show all photos' button
Review scorecard chrome -- renders: 'Exceptional' score badge, 'Guest reviews' heading, and 'See all reviews' button; subtracts the list of user-generated review snippets
Map widget controls -- renders: 'Show on map' button

Availability section chrome -- renders: 'Availability' heading, 'Price guarantee' button, and search date/occupancy controls; subtracts the room availability table containing host-supplied room names, descriptions, and prices
Q&A section chrome -- renders: 'Questions and answers' heading, 'Ask a question' button, and 'See all questions' button; subtracts the list of user-generated questions
Surroundings section chrome -- renders: 'Surroundings' heading, 'Show on map' button, and category labels (Airport, Beach, etc.); subtracts the lists of place names and distances
Facilities section chrome -- renders: 'Facilities' heading, 'Show all facilities' button, and 'Property facilities' subheading; subtracts the list of facility names
User survey widget -- renders: 'How was your experience?' question and fixed rating options (Very poor to Very good)
Policies section -- renders: 'Policies' heading and standard platform policy labels (Check-in, Check-out, Children, Pets, etc.)
Important information section -- renders: 'Important information' heading and standard platform disclaimer text
FAQ section -- renders: 'Frequently asked questions' heading and standard platform FAQ questions
Site footer -- renders: fixed navigation links (Support, Partners, About), language/currency selectors, and legal links
